passages.text: Each terminal is provisioned centrally and assigned to a store location before shipment. On first power-on, staff enter the store's activation code from the manager portal to bind the terminal.
passages.title: Cascade POS Terminal — Store Operations Manual

passages.text: At close of business, staff run "End of Day" from the terminal menu, which totals cash and card transactions and compares them against the expected drawer amount. Discrepancies over $10 must be logged in the manager portal.
passages.title: Cascade POS Terminal — Store Operations Manual

passages.text: Refunds require a manager PIN for any amount over $100. Refunds to a card must use the original card; cash refunds are permitted for cash purchases under $100 without manager approval.
passages.title: Cascade POS Terminal — Store Operations Manual

passages.text: Error E01 indicates a card reader connection failure; restart the terminal. Error E12 indicates the terminal has lost sync with the manager portal and transactions will queue locally until connectivity is restored. Error E30 indicates a receipt printer paper jam.
passages.title: Cascade POS Terminal — Store Operations Manual

passages.text: Clean the card reader slot weekly with a dry contact cleaning card. Receipt paper should be replaced only with the thermal paper specified in the hardware kit; other paper can damage the print head.
passages.title: Cascade POS Terminal — Store Operations Manual

passages.text: Store hardware issues go through the internal IT helpdesk, not the public customer support FAQ.
passages.title: Cascade POS Terminal — Store Operations Manual

passages.text: Items may be returned within 30 days of purchase with a valid receipt or order confirmation.
passages.title: Returns and Refunds Policy

passages.text: Returned items must be unused, in original packaging, with all tags attached. Items showing signs of use are not eligible for return.
passages.title: Returns and Refunds Policy

passages.text: Refunds are issued only to the original payment method. Cash refunds for card purchases are not available.
passages.title: Returns and Refunds Policy

passages.text: Final-sale and clearance items cannot be returned. Gift cards are non-refundable.
passages.title: Returns and Refunds Policy

passages.text: Items may be returned within 45 days of purchase with a valid receipt or order confirmation. This extends the 30-day window from the prior version of this policy. Electronics are an exception: they must be returned within 14 days.
passages.title: Returns and Refunds Policy

passages.text: Returned items must be unused, in original packaging, with all tags attached. Items showing signs of use are not eligible for return.
passages.title: Returns and Refunds Policy

passages.text: Refunds may be issued to the original payment method, or as store credit if the customer prefers store credit and the item is not a final-sale item. Cash refunds for card purchases are still not available.
passages.title: Returns and Refunds Policy

passages.text: Final-sale and clearance items cannot be returned. Gift cards are non-refundable. Electronics follow the 14-day window stated above rather than the general 45-day window.
passages.title: Returns and Refunds Policy

passages.text: For missing or damaged items, contact support within 7 days of delivery with your order number. Cascade will send a replacement or issue a refund per the current Returns and Refunds Policy.
passages.title: Cascade Retail Co — Customer Support FAQ

passages.text: Electronics sold by Cascade carry the manufacturer's warranty only; Cascade does not offer an extended warranty program. Warranty claims go directly to the manufacturer.
passages.title: Cascade Retail Co — Customer Support FAQ

passages.text: Store hours and addresses are listed on the Cascade website store locator. Holiday hours may differ from standard hours and are posted at each store.
passages.title: Cascade Retail Co — Customer Support FAQ

passages.text: The Cascade Rewards program gives 1 point per dollar spent. 100 points equal a $5 reward. Points expire 12 months after the last purchase on the account.
passages.title: Cascade Retail Co — Customer Support FAQ

passages.text: Reimbursable business expenses include travel (airfare, mileage at the IRS standard rate, lodging), client meals up to $50 per person, and approved training or certification fees.
passages.title: Expense Reimbursement Policy

passages.text: Expenses are submitted through the finance portal with itemized receipts attached within 30 days of the expense. Expenses submitted after 60 days are not reimbursed except by CFO exception.
passages.title: Expense Reimbursement Policy

passages.text: Expenses under $200 are auto-approved after manager sign-off. Expenses of $200 to $1,000 require director approval. Expenses over $1,000 require CFO approval regardless of category.
passages.title: Expense Reimbursement Policy

passages.text: Alcohol, personal entertainment, traffic or parking fines, and home office equipment are not reimbursable under this policy. Home office equipment for approved remote employees is instead covered under the separate Remote Work Policy's home office stipend, where applicable.
passages.title: Expense Reimbursement Policy

passages.text: New employees can enroll in health, dental, and vision benefits within 30 days of their start date. Outside of that window, changes are allowed only during the annual open enrollment period or after a qualifying life event.
passages.title: Meridian Health Partners — HR FAQ

passages.text: Meridian offers 12 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 4 weeks for the secondary caregiver, following the birth, adoption, or foster placement of a child. Leave must be taken within 12 months of the qualifying event.
passages.title: Meridian Health Partners — HR FAQ

passages.text: Questions about eligibility, approved remote days, and the home office stipend are governed by the current Remote Work Policy, not by this FAQ. Employees should consult that policy directly, since remote work terms have changed over time.
passages.title: Meridian Health Partners — HR FAQ

passages.text: Employees are paid semi-monthly, on the 15th and the last business day of the month. Direct deposit is required; there is no paper check option.
passages.title: Meridian Health Partners — HR FAQ

passages.text: Full-time employees accrue PTO at a rate of 1.25 days per month, or 15 days per year. Part-time employees accrue a prorated amount based on scheduled hours. PTO begins accruing from the first day of employment but cannot be used until after 30 days.
passages.title: Paid Time Off (PTO) Policy

passages.text: Up to 5 unused PTO days may be carried over into the next calendar year. Any balance above 5 days is forfeited on January 1 unless local law requires otherwise.
passages.title: Paid Time Off (PTO) Policy

passages.text: PTO requests must be submitted through the HR portal at least 2 weeks in advance for planned absences. Requests for fewer than 2 days' notice require manager approval and are granted only if staffing allows.
passages.title: Paid Time Off (PTO) Policy

passages.text: Upon separation from the company, employees are paid out for unused accrued PTO up to a maximum of 10 days, at their final base rate of pay.
passages.title: Paid Time Off (PTO) Policy

passages.text: This policy sets the conditions under which Meridian Health Partners employees may work remotely instead of at a designated office.
passages.title: Remote Work Policy

passages.text: Remote work is available to employees in non-clinical roles who have completed 90 days of employment and have manager approval. Clinical and front-desk roles are not eligible.
passages.title: Remote Work Policy

passages.text: Remote work is limited to a maximum of 2 days per week. Employees must be reachable during the core hours of 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM in their local time zone.
passages.title: Remote Work Policy

passages.text: Remote work is bring-your-own-device. Meridian does not provide a stipend or reimbursement for home office equipment under this policy.
passages.title: Remote Work Policy

passages.text: Employees submit a remote work request to their manager, who approves or denies it within 5 business days. Approval must be renewed every 6 months.
passages.title: Remote Work Policy

passages.text: This policy sets the conditions under which Meridian Health Partners employees may work remotely instead of at a designated office. It replaces the version 1.0 remote work policy effective 2025-06-01.
passages.title: Remote Work Policy

passages.text: Remote work is available to employees in non-clinical roles who have completed 90 days of employment and have manager approval. Clinical and front-desk roles are not eligible. Fully remote arrangements now require additionally a director-level sign-off.
passages.title: Remote Work Policy

passages.text: Employees in approved fully-remote roles may work remotely 5 days per week. Employees without director sign-off remain limited to 2 days per week. All remote employees must be reachable during the core hours of 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM in their local time zone.
passages.title: Remote Work Policy

passages.text: Meridian provides a one-time home office stipend of $500 for approved remote employees, covering desk, chair, or monitor purchases. Receipts must be submitted within 60 days of approval.
passages.title: Remote Work Policy

passages.text: The $500 stipend introduced under this policy is separate from, and not deducted against, the general expense reimbursement limits in the Expense Reimbursement Policy.
passages.title: Remote Work Policy

passages.text: Employees submit a remote work request to their manager, who approves or denies it within 5 business days. Fully-remote requests also require director sign-off within 10 business days. Approval must be renewed every 6 months.
passages.title: Remote Work Policy

passages.text: CloudVault is Solstice Systems' file backup agent. It runs as a background service and uploads changed files to the customer's configured storage bucket on a schedule.
passages.title: CloudVault Backup Tool — User Manual

passages.text: CloudVault supports Windows 10/11 and macOS 12 or later. There is no Linux agent; Linux hosts must use the CloudVault command-line uploader instead, which lacks the scheduling UI.
passages.title: CloudVault Backup Tool — User Manual

passages.text: Backups can be scheduled hourly, daily, or weekly from the CloudVault dashboard. The default schedule for new installs is daily at 2:00 AM local time. Manual "Backup Now" runs are always available regardless of schedule.
passages.title: CloudVault Backup Tool — User Manual

passages.text: To restore files, open the CloudVault dashboard, select a snapshot by date, and choose "Restore to original location" or "Restore to new folder." Restores of more than 50 GB require confirmation because they can take several hours.
passages.title: CloudVault Backup Tool — User Manual

passages.text: All data is encrypted client-side with AES-256 before upload, using a key derived from the account's recovery passphrase. Solstice does not store the passphrase and cannot recover data if it is lost.
passages.title: CloudVault Backup Tool — User Manual

passages.text: A failed backup most often means the local disk is full or the recovery passphrase was changed without updating the agent. Check the agent log at the path shown in Settings > Diagnostics > Log Location. If the log shows repeated `AUTH_EXPIRED` errors, re-authenticate the agent from the dashboard.
passages.title: CloudVault Backup Tool — User Manual

passages.text: Support requests go through the customer portal ticket form. There is no phone support. Typical first response time is one business day.
passages.title: CloudVault Backup Tool — User Manual

passages.text: Solstice Systems sells two products: the SecureLink VPN client and the CloudVault backup tool. Both are sold as a single combined subscription; they cannot be purchased separately.
passages.title: Solstice Systems — Customer FAQ

passages.text: The combined subscription is billed per seat, monthly or annually. Annual billing gets two months free compared to paying monthly for twelve months. There is no free tier; a 14-day trial is available on signup.
passages.title: Solstice Systems — Customer FAQ

passages.text: Seats are added or removed from the admin console under Billing > Seats. Removing a seat immediately revokes that user's SecureLink and CloudVault access but keeps their CloudVault backup snapshots for 30 days before deletion.
passages.title: Solstice Systems — Customer FAQ

passages.text: Support is ticket-based only, through the customer portal, for all products. There is no live chat and no phone line.
passages.title: Solstice Systems — Customer FAQ

passages.text: Subscriptions can be canceled anytime from Billing > Subscription. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period; there are no partial refunds for the unused portion of a period.
passages.title: Solstice Systems — Customer FAQ

passages.text: SecureLink is Solstice Systems' desktop VPN client for Windows, macOS and Linux. It establishes an encrypted tunnel to a Solstice gateway using WireGuard as the default protocol, with OpenVPN available as a fallback for networks that block UDP.
passages.title: SecureLink VPN Client — User Manual

passages.text: Download the installer from the Solstice customer portal. On Windows and macOS, run the installer and accept the network extension prompt. On Linux, install the provided `.deb` or `.rpm` package, which registers a systemd service named `securelink`.
passages.title: SecureLink VPN Client — User Manual

passages.text: SecureLink requires a company SSO login on first launch. Sessions are cached for 12 hours. Two-factor authentication is enforced automatically if the organization has 2FA enabled in the admin console; there is no per-user opt-out.
passages.title: SecureLink VPN Client — User Manual

passages.text: Split tunneling is supported starting in version 3.0. When enabled, traffic to addresses listed in the "excluded routes" panel bypasses the VPN tunnel and goes directly to the local network. Split tunneling is off by default and must be turned on in Settings > Network > Split Tunneling.
passages.title: SecureLink VPN Client — User Manual

passages.text: If the connection drops repeatedly, first check that the device clock is within 5 minutes of actual time, since certificate validation fails on clock skew. Next, switch the protocol from WireGuard to OpenVPN in Settings > Protocol, which resolves drops caused by UDP throttling on some ISPs. If drops continue, capture a diagnostic bundle via Help > Export Diagnostics and open a support ticket.
passages.title: SecureLink VPN Client — User Manual

passages.text: On Windows, uninstall via Settings > Apps. On macOS, drag the app to Trash and run the included `uninstall.sh` script to remove the network extension. On Linux, use the system package manager to remove the `securelink` package.
passages.title: SecureLink VPN Client — User Manual

passages.text: Support requests go through the customer portal ticket form. There is no phone support. Typical first response time is one business day.
passages.title: SecureLink VPN Client — User Manual
